resources.string:
Lookup packs

This component offers lookups in a set of small structured databases: Astronomy, Zodiac signs and birthstones, the NATO phonetic alphabet, and Greek letters.

Choose the pack and, in the field menu, the sort column (or All fields). With an empty query, Search lists the whole pack as a table: one row per record and one column per field. Tap a column header to sort by that column; tap again to reverse the order.

Type a value and press Search to filter the rows instead. Identity lookups use display names, aliases and symbols; text fields match as substrings and numeric or date fields compare as equal values. A birth date such as Mar 21 or 3/21 yields the corresponding zodiac sign.

In the NATO pack a plain identity query can also go both ways over whole strings: a word such as SIFRY returns its spelling Sierra India Foxtrot Romeo Yankee.
